title: Hailey Bieber shares video of son Jack Blues playing the keyboard
text:

 News Finance More Mail Search the web Advertisement Advertisement Return to homepage Hailey Bieber shares video of son Jack Blues playing the keyboard
 Sameen Chaudhry, USA TODAY Updated Fri, 13 November 2026 at 6:28 pm UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Hailey and Justin Bieber's 2-year-old son, Jack Blues Bieber, seems to share his dad's love for music.
 Hailey Bieber shared a sweet video of her son playing a small electronic keyboard ⁠ on her Instagram story Thursday, Nov. 12. Dressed in bright pink sweats and a knit cap, the toddler leans over a wooden coffee table and taps out notes with one hand while the camera zooms in him.
 "Blues loves the keys," the Rhode founder wrote across the clip ⁠. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Jack Blues has joined his dad at the piano before. In June, Hailey Bieber's Father's Day photo of Justin Bieber and Jack at the piano ⁠ caught the two from behind. "Have you ever seen 2 heads be so similar?" she wrote of their matching haircuts. 
 Clearly the apple doesn't fall far from the tree. In 2011, Justin Bieber 's mother, Pattie Mallette, told Vanity Fair ⁠ that the "Baby" singer could barely stand at 1 but was already "banging on tables, banging in rhythm."
 Mallette began posting videos of Justin Bieber singing on YouTube so his grandmother and other relatives could watch. The clips also caught the attention of music manager Scooter Braun, who introduced Justin to Usher. Together, they helped him land a record deal with Island Def Jam in 2008 .⁠
 Justin announced Jack's birth ⁠ on Aug. 23, 2024, with a photo of Hailey holding their newborn's foot . Jack was nearly 1 when he joined both parents in the music video for "Yukon," ⁠ a track from Justin's album "Swag." Justin kisses his son's toes in the black-and-white video⁠.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Justin shared photos from a family outing ⁠ on Oct. 3. Jack holds his dad's hand as they stand near kangaroos in one picture. In another, Hailey stands beside him as he reaches up to offer a giraffe some leaves. 
 Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber arrives for the 68th annual Grammy Awards at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles on Feb. 1, 2026. Hailey opened up in October about her health after Jack's birth. She told Women's Wear Daily ⁠ that she struggled with premenstrual dysphoric disorder ⁠. "Conversation, for me personally, makes me feel less alone," she said. 
 "As a woman, I feel frustrated by the lack of research, the lack of awareness, the lack of certain conversation around it," she told the outlet. "Especially after having my own child. That was just a really intense and special journey that I had. There's so much that happens when you are pregnant, during childbirth. There's so many things that happen leading up to having a child."
 Contributing: Taijuan Moorman, USA TODAY
